description: Back row: Aunt Ollie, Aunt Lola, Ida O'Keeffe, Alexis O'Keeffe, unknown woman, Anita O'Keeffe Young. Front row: Eleanor Jane Young, Catherine O'Keeffe Krueger, Raymond Krueger, Catherine Klenert Krueger. Georgia O'Keeffe's aunts, younger siblings, and their children.
